title: Themed icons, motion and a devlog
summary: Each theme now has a matching home-screen icon, the app moves when it charges, and tapping the version opens this devlog.
notes: Four launcher icons, one per theme, and the home-screen icon switches when you pick a theme.
The top gauge and the battery health bar animate while charging.
Settings slide in and out, and the back gesture follows your finger.
A clock-face dial sets how often the notification updates.
A full-width 24h / 7d / 30d / All bar with a sliding highlight.
Stop and Restrict are now icon buttons with themed tooltips.
Pinch to zoom the battery level and temperature charts, and a curved line option for the capacity trend.
Smoother everywhere: charts redraw without rebuilding the screen, data loads off the main thread, and the app ships a baseline profile so it is compiled ahead of time.
Uses the full 120 Hz on high-refresh screens while something is moving, and drops back when idle to save battery.
Bradshaw Versioning from this release, and a paginated devlog behind the version number in the footer.
The project is ready to be published as open source.

title: The four Flygon LC house themes
summary: The theme picker now offers the real Flygon LC house styles.
notes: Themes are now Flygon LC, Othello, System Boring and Night, using the house style catalog's colors, fonts and corner sizes.
Bundled Press Start 2P, Source Sans 3, Instrument Serif and Instrument Sans so headings match the web.
The app starts on Night in dark mode and on System Boring otherwise.

title: Four themes, not five
summary: Removed the extra theme so the picker lists exactly four.
notes: Removed the fifth, original-look theme from the picker.
Anyone on the removed theme moves to the default automatically.

title: Theme picker
summary: Settings gained a theme picker with a preview for each theme.
notes: Pick a theme at the top of Settings; the whole app switches at once and remembers the choice.
Each theme sets its own colors, heading font and corner shape.
Status bar icons turn dark on light themes so they stay readable.

title: Settings and a quieter notification
summary: A settings screen to control how often the live notification updates.
notes: New Settings screen behind the gear icon.
Choose how often the live notification updates, from every 10 seconds to every 15 minutes.
Options to show live values or a static notification, and to update only while the screen is on.
Sampling keeps running at full rate, so capacity measurements are unaffected.

title: What's draining your battery
summary: A new card estimates which apps use the most battery over time.
notes: Apps ranked by estimated mAh over 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or all time, with screen time and mAh per hour.
Each app's change from the previous period, and its mAh per day when you tap it.
A background activity list shows which apps keep services running or use the most background data.
A Stop / restrict button opens that app's system page.
action: Grant Usage access from the new card so the tracker can tell which app is open.

title: Real capacity measurement
summary: Battery health now comes from measured charge, not the phone's own estimate.
notes: Counts the current flowing in during a charge and divides by how much the level rose, giving a real full-charge capacity.
A background monitor with a small notification showing level, watts and temperature.
The health card shows Measuring… with live progress until a charge of 15% or more completes.
Charge cycles are hidden when the phone reports 0.
action: Allow notifications, and set OneBattery's battery usage to Unrestricted.

title: OneBattery by Flygon LC
summary: First release: live battery stats, a health estimate and history, all stored on the phone.
notes: Live screen updating every 2 seconds: level, charging state, time to full or empty, watts, temperature, voltage and current.
Battery health and wear compared with the S24 Ultra's 5,000 mAh design capacity.
Battery level and temperature charts for 24h, 7d, 30d or all time, plus a capacity trend.
Usage stats: average drain, how long a full charge lasts, charge count and temperatures.
Logs a reading every 15 minutes, on plug and unplug, and after a reboot. Data stays on the phone.
